cd /app && cat > extract.py <<'EOF'
import cv2, numpy as np, pickle
cap=cv2.VideoCapture('/app/video.mp4')
ys=np.concatenate([np.arange(round(41+25.714*i), round(41+25.714*i)+25) for i in range(1,26)])
xs=np.concatenate([np.arange(round(12.8*c), round(12.8*c)+13) for c in range(10,90)])
frames=[]   # list of (frame_idx, rowhashes)
glyphs={}   # hash -> bitmap
rows={}     # rowhash -> tuple of cell hashes
n=0
while True:
    ok, fr = cap.read()
    if not ok: break
    if n % 3 == 0:
        g = cv2.cvtColor(fr, cv2.COLOR_BGR2GRAY)
        b = (g[np.ix_(ys,xs)] > 100)
        cells = b.reshape(25,25,80,13).transpose(0,2,1,3)  # row, col, 25,13
        pack = np.packbits(cells.reshape(25,80,-1), axis=-1)
        rh=[]
        for r in range(25):
            ch=[]
            for c in range(80):
                h = pack[r,c].tobytes()
                if h not in glyphs: glyphs[h]=cells[r,c]
                ch.append(h)
            t=tuple(ch)
            k=hash(t)
            rows[k]=t
            rh.append(k)
        frames.append((n, rh))
    n+=1
print('frames', n, 'sampled', len(frames), 'unique glyphs', len(glyphs), 'unique rows', len(rows))
pickle.dump({'frames':frames,'glyphs':glyphs,'rows':rows}, open('/app/data.pkl','wb'))
EOF

import cv2, numpy as np, pickle
cap=cv2.VideoCapture('/app/video.mp4')
ys=np.concatenate([np.arange(round(41+25.714*i), round(41+25.714*i)+25) for i in range(1,26)])
xs=np.concatenate([np.arange(round(12.8*c), round(12.8*c)+13) for c in range(10,90)])
tmpl=np.zeros((0,325),np.float32); tnorm=np.zeros((0,),np.float32); tcount=[]
screens=[]  # (frame_idx, 25x80 int array of template id, -1 blank)
prev=None
n=0
while True:
    ok, fr = cap.read()
    if not ok: break
    if n % 3 == 0:
        g = cv2.cvtColor(fr, cv2.COLOR_BGR2GRAY)[np.ix_(ys,xs)].astype(np.float32)
        if prev is not None and np.abs(g-prev).mean() < 0.3:
            screens.append((n, screens[-1][1])); n+=1; continue
        prev=g
        cells = g.reshape(25,25,80,13).transpose(0,2,1,3).reshape(2000,325)
        ids=np.full(2000,-1,np.int32)
        act = cells.max(1) > 60
        idx=np.nonzero(act)[0]
        if len(idx):
            X=cells[idx]
            X=X-X.mean(1,keepdims=True)
            Xn=np.linalg.norm(X,axis=1)+1e-6
            for k,i in enumerate(idx):
                if len(tmpl):
                    sim = (tmpl@X[k])/(tnorm*Xn[k])
                    j=int(np.argmax(sim))
                    if sim[j] > 0.93:
                        ids[i]=j; continue
                v=X[k]
                tmpl=np.vstack([tmpl, v]); tnorm=np.append(tnorm, np.linalg.norm(v))
                ids[i]=len(tmpl)-1
        screens.append((n, ids.reshape(25,80)))
    n+=1
print('sampled', len(screens), 'templates', len(tmpl))
pickle.dump({'screens':screens,'tmpl':tmpl}, open('/app/data2.pkl','wb'))
EOF

cd /app && cat > extract3.py <<'EOF'
import cv2, numpy as np, pickle
CW, CH = 12.8, 25.714285
X0, Y0 = 128.0, 41.0
W,H = 13, 25   # samples per cell
mx=np.zeros((25*H, 80*W), np.float32); my=np.zeros_like(mx)
for r in range(25):
    for m in range(H):
        my[r*H+m,:] = Y0 + (r+1)*CH + (m+0.5)*CH/H
for c in range(80):
    for k in range(W):
        mx[:, c*W+k] = X0 + (c+10-10)*CW + (k+0.5)*CW/W
# note col index in screen = c (0..79) -> x = 128 + c*12.8
cap=cv2.VideoCapture('/app/video.mp4')
tmpl=np.zeros((0,W*H),np.float32); tnorm=np.zeros((0,),np.float32)
screens=[]; prev=None; n=0
while True:
    ok, fr = cap.read()
    if not ok: break
    if n%3==0:
        g=cv2.cvtColor(fr, cv2.COLOR_BGR2GRAY).astype(np.float32)
        s=cv2.remap(g, mx, my, cv2.INTER_LINEAR)
        if prev is not None and np.abs(s-prev).mean()<0.3:
            screens.append((n, screens[-1][1])); n+=1; continue
        prev=s
        cells=s.reshape(25,H,80,W).transpose(0,2,1,3).reshape(2000,W*H)
        ids=np.full(2000,-1,np.int32)
        idx=np.nonzero(cells.max(1)>60)[0]
        if len(idx):
            Xa=cells[idx]; Xa=Xa-Xa.mean(1,keepdims=True)
            Xn=np.linalg.norm(Xa,axis=1)+1e-6
            for k,i in enumerate(idx):
                if len(tmpl):
                    sim=(tmpl@Xa[k])/(tnorm*Xn[k]); j=int(np.argmax(sim))
                    if sim[j]>0.95: ids[i]=j; continue
                v=Xa[k]; tmpl=np.vstack([tmpl,v]); tnorm=np.append(tnorm,np.linalg.norm(v)); ids[i]=len(tmpl)-1
        screens.append((n, ids.reshape(25,80)))
    n+=1
print('sampled',len(screens),'templates',len(tmpl))
pickle.dump({'screens':screens,'tmpl':tmpl,'shape':(H,W)}, open('/app/data3.pkl','wb'))
EOF
